title: Breakfast Baked Potato with Egg, Sausage, and Cheese
description: A creative breakfast dish featuring a hollowed baked potato filled with a mixture of eggs, sausage, and cheese, topped with a cheesy bacon, garlic butter, chives, and sour cream piped topping.
steps: Hollow out the baked potato to create a blank canvas.
Mix the potato with cheese, bacon, garlic butter, chives, and sour cream.
Prepare the egg filling by whisking eggs with sausage and cheese, cooking until just under soft scrambled consistency.
Stuff the egg mixture inside the hollowed baked potato.
Optionally, bake the stuffed potato to achieve a crispy tip.
Pipe the potato mixture on top of the egg filling.
